Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

539-728-789-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-789-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Gutter Grime triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2478-2866-4986-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat

Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.

3293-5282-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have a Plains exiled by Wormfang Newt.
3293-5282-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Wormfang Newt.
When Wormfang Newt dies, its second ability triggers, returning a Plains from exile to the battlefield.
When the Plains enters the battlefield, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning Wormfang Newt from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Newt enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling a Plains.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, adding {W}.

Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Human Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1164-2056-4084-4243.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli has at least three loyalty counters.
1164-2056-4084-4243.description:
Cast Part the Waterveil by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Saheeli triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve Part the Waterveil, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile it.
Activate Saheeli by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing the Servo to become a copy of Mirror of Fate until end of turn.
Activate the Servo by tapping and sacrificing it, choosing Part the Waterveil and up to six other cards face up in exile, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top of your library, with Part the Waterveil being the top most card.
If Saheeli has less than three loyalty counters on it, activate Venser's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, exiling Saheeli until your next end step.
At the beginning of your end step, if you activated Venser's ability, Venser triggers, returning Saheeli from exile to the battlefield.
Move to your next turn, drawing Part the Waterveil during your draw step.
Repeat.

730-1479-3147.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
730-1479-3147.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Emeria Angel, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Emeria Angel trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
